statement: No cell has Control-Room-approved explicit external rights for production AUTHORIZED_EXTERNAL_SCREENSHOT capture. CR-LV-METHOD-B-TO-C-FOUR-CELL-PILOT-20260727-01 reclassified all former Method B lessons to Method C / INSTRUCTIONAL_COMPOSITION (NO_VALID_RIGHTS_BASIS). The Category B methodology sample under docs/lesson-visuals/controlled-v1/golden/methodology-b-builder-m6-l3.png remains a quality/format reference only and does NOT constitute a production rights grant.
consequence: AUTHORIZED_EXTERNAL_SCREENSHOT lesson count is zero. Any future AUTHORIZED_EXTERNAL_SCREENSHOT cell would still fail closed via src/lib/lesson-visuals/controlled-v1/routes/authorizedExternal.ts without a per-cell rights evidence file under this rights/ directory.
howToGrantRights: To unblock a specific AUTHORIZED_EXTERNAL_SCREENSHOT cell, a Control-Room-approved rights evidence file must be added at docs/lesson-visuals/controlled-v1/rights/{lessonId}__{locale}.rights.json (or docs/lesson-visuals/controlled-v1/rights/{lessonId}.rights.json) matching the schema in src/lib/lesson-visuals/controlled-v1/routes/authorizedExternal.ts. No such file currently exists for any lesson.
